# The truck drives it twice. Price it twice.

> Price a bounce house or inflatable rental booking from the truck's two round trips, setup and teardown labor, a generator when there is no outlet, a wet-unit attendant, and insurance sized to your fleet's replacement value — not just a flat per-unit-per-day rate. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
